press_references.value: Fabric Launches Orchestra, the Industry’s First AI-Native Platform to Democratize Automated Fulfillment and Cut Costs

product_launches.description: Fabric launched Orchestra, an AI-native fulfillment software suite that unifies robotics, customer experience, inventory and labor management—featuring Ops Pilot and Digital Planogram—to cut costs and simplify onboarding for retailers.

overview_description.description:
fabric’s mission is to accelerate the GMV of the Internet by ending the pain of replatforming. By democratizing access to best-in-class digital commerce tooling, fabric allows merchants who aren’t served well by Shopify, Oracle, or Salesforce (and other hosted platforms) to thrive in an e-commerce world. Customers like BuildDirect and GNC trust fabric for its open and modular design that allows them to be live within just a few months without having to replatform. fabric is a force multiplier on retailers’ existing technology investments proven to grow digital revenue by up to 3x.

Headquartered in the Cloud Capital Seattle, Washington, with offices and customers around the world, fabric is backed by SoftBank, Glynn Capital, Forerunner Ventures, Stripes, B Capital Group, Greycroft, Norwest Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, Innovation Global Capital, Ascend Venture Capital, and Expa. To learn more, visit https://fabric.inc

product.name: fabric NEON
product.description: An agentic commerce platform that helps retailers optimize product data, improve AI search visibility, and orchestrate commerce operations across channels.

product.name: Product Agent
product.description: An agentic product data solution that monitors AI search visibility, enriches catalog content, and distributes structured product information to demand channels.

product.name: fabric Order Management (OMS)
product.description: An API-driven order management system for managing inventory, orders, fulfillment rules, delivery options, and post-purchase workflows across sales channels.

product.name: Smart Order Routing
product.description: A fulfillment optimization solution that tests and applies routing rules to reduce split shipments, improve delivery performance, and lower fulfillment costs.

product.name: fabric Product Catalog
product.description: A product catalog management system for onboarding products, organizing categories and collections, enriching product data, and publishing catalog updates in real time.

product.name: fabric Offers
product.description: A promotion and pricing management solution for configuring rules-based offers and adjusting prices based on customer, product, category, cart, or shopping conditions.
